policy_text:
Ostrava-Lune Foundation, Halbrecht Early Inquiry Grants: eligibility rules (2027 cycle)
An application is approved only if it meets every rule below. Rules marked as defaults say what to assume when an application is silent on a point.

R1. If an application says nothing about data sharing, treat it as lacking an open data plan.
R2. Every proposal must include an open data plan, unless the host is a teaching hospital bound by patient privacy rules.
R3. Equipment may account for no more than $25,000.
R4. The lead applicant must have received a doctorate no more than 8 years before 2027. This rule does not apply if the applicant has a documented Corran career break and the doctorate is at most 10 years old.
R5. Applications hosted by a teaching hospital may budget at most $5,000 for travel.
R6. The total requested amount may not exceed $70,000. This rule does not apply if the host is a community laboratory and the request is at most $100,000.
R7. If the type of host institution is not stated, treat the host as an independent institute.
R8. The project period, from start date to end date, may not exceed 65 weeks.
R9. Equipment and travel together may not exceed $40,000.
R10. Research with human participants requires approval from the Mereth ethics board.

Case File: HEI-7943

Lead Applicant: Dr. Ilse Varnholt
Host Institution: Community laboratory

Project Details:
Title shortened at the suggestion of the host's grants office. Project start date: March 15, 2027. Project end date: May 8, 2028. Project period: 60 weeks.
